case_aircraft_defining_check.name: case_aircraft_defining_check
case_aircraft_defining_check.value: ("case_aircraft"."defining_occurrence_no" is null) = ("case_aircraft"."defining_phase_group" is null) and not ("case_aircraft"."defining_event_conflict" and "case_aircraft"."defining_occurrence_no" is not null)

case_sections_scope_check.name: case_sections_scope_check
case_sections_scope_check.value: ("case_sections"."scope" = 'aircraft' and "case_sections"."aircraft_key" is not null and "case_sections"."source_aircraft_keys" = array["case_sections"."aircraft_key"]) or ("case_sections"."scope" = 'event' and "case_sections"."aircraft_key" is null and cardinality("case_sections"."source_aircraft_keys") >= 1)

cases_location_check.name: cases_location_check
cases_location_check.value:
("cases"."latitude" is null) = ("cases"."longitude" is null)
        and ("cases"."latitude" is null or "cases"."latitude" between -90 and 90)
        and ("cases"."longitude" is null or "cases"."longitude" between -180 and 180)

dataset_generations_verification_check.name: dataset_generations_verification_check
dataset_generations_verification_check.value:
("dataset_generations"."verification_status" is null) = ("dataset_generations"."verified_at" is null)
        and ("dataset_generations"."verification_status" is null) = ("dataset_generations"."verifier_version" is null)
        and ("dataset_generations"."verification_status" is null) = ("dataset_generations"."verification_report_sha256" is null)
        and ("dataset_generations"."verification_status" is null or "dataset_generations"."verification_status" in ('ok', 'failed'))
        and ("dataset_generations"."verification_report_sha256" is null or "dataset_generations"."verification_report_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
        and ("dataset_generations"."status" <> 'verified' or "dataset_generations"."verification_status" = 'ok')
        and ("dataset_generations"."status" <> 'failed' or "dataset_generations"."verification_status" = 'failed')
        and ("dataset_generations"."status" not in ('loading', 'loaded') or "dataset_generations"."verification_status" is null)

cost_ledger_principal_check.name: cost_ledger_principal_check
cost_ledger_principal_check.value:
("cost_ledger"."principal_kind" = 'system') = ("cost_ledger"."principal_hash" is null)
        and ("cost_ledger"."principal_hash" is null or "cost_ledger"."principal_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

reservations_principal_check.name: reservations_principal_check
reservations_principal_check.value:
("reservations"."principal_kind" = 'system') = ("reservations"."principal_hash" is null)
        and (("reservations"."category" = 'interactive') = ("reservations"."principal_kind" <> 'system')
          or ("reservations"."category" = 'interactive' and "reservations"."principal_kind" = 'system' and "reservations"."stage" = 'restore_reconcile'))
        and ("reservations"."principal_hash" is null or "reservations"."principal_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

reservations_settlement_check.name: reservations_settlement_check
reservations_settlement_check.value:
("reservations"."status" = 'open') = ("reservations"."settled_at" is null)
        and ("reservations"."status" = 'open') = ("reservations"."charged_usd" is null)
        and ("reservations"."status" = 'open') = ("reservations"."uncertain" is null)
        and ("reservations"."charged_usd" is null or "reservations"."charged_usd" >= 0)
        and ("reservations"."status" <> 'expired_charged' or ("reservations"."charged_usd" >= "reservations"."usd" and "reservations"."uncertain"))

index_switch_attempts_declared_check.name: index_switch_attempts_declared_check
index_switch_attempts_declared_check.value:
("index_switch_attempts"."declared_abandoned_at" is null) = ("index_switch_attempts"."declared_reason" is null)
        and ("index_switch_attempts"."declared_reason" is null or ("index_switch_attempts"."declared_reason" ~ '\S' and length("index_switch_attempts"."declared_reason") <= 500))
        and ("index_switch_attempts"."declared_abandoned_at" is null or "index_switch_attempts"."outcome" in ('unknown', 'committed'))

passages_scope_check.name: passages_scope_check
passages_scope_check.value:
("passages"."scope" = 'aircraft' and "passages"."aircraft_key" is not null and "passages"."aircraft_specific")
        or ("passages"."scope" = 'event' and "passages"."aircraft_key" is null and not "passages"."aircraft_specific")

passages_span_check.name: passages_span_check
passages_span_check.value:
"passages"."start" >= 0 and "passages"."end" > "passages"."start" and "passages"."part" between 1 and "passages"."parts"
        and (not "passages"."continuation" or "passages"."part" > 1) and "passages"."token_count" between 1 and 8192

brief_steps_state_check.name: brief_steps_state_check
brief_steps_state_check.value:
("brief_steps"."status" = 'running') = ("brief_steps"."stage" in ('scope', 'retrieve', 'compose', 'validate'))
        and ("brief_steps"."stage" <> 'done' or "brief_steps"."status" in ('answered', 'no_match', 'withheld', 'scope_reply', 'no_results'))
        and ("brief_steps"."stage" <> 'failed' or "brief_steps"."status" in ('failed', 'cancelled'))
        and ("brief_steps"."status" = 'running') = ("brief_steps"."finished_at" is null)
        and ("brief_steps"."status" = 'running' or "brief_steps"."result" is not null)

auth_accounts_values_check.name: auth_accounts_values_check
auth_accounts_values_check.value:
"auth_accounts"."provider_id" = 'google' and "auth_accounts"."account_id" ~ '^[!-~]{1,255}$'
        and "auth_accounts"."access_token" is null and "auth_accounts"."refresh_token" is null and "auth_accounts"."id_token" is null
        and "auth_accounts"."access_token_expires_at" is null and "auth_accounts"."refresh_token_expires_at" is null
        and "auth_accounts"."scope" is null and "auth_accounts"."password" is null

auth_sessions_values_check.name: auth_sessions_values_check
auth_sessions_values_check.value: "auth_sessions"."ip_address" is null and "auth_sessions"."user_agent" is null and length("auth_sessions"."token") between 16 and 255 and "auth_sessions"."expires_at" > "auth_sessions"."created_at"

auth_users_values_check.name: auth_users_values_check
auth_users_values_check.value: "auth_users"."email_verified" and "auth_users"."image" is null and length("auth_users"."name") <= 200 and length("auth_users"."email") between 3 and 320
